question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**around**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the orbit of the Earth in relation to the sun.
 
• The appropriate preposition should describe the orbit's pathway in relation to the sun.
 
• "**Around**" fits well as it denotes the path of the Earth's orbit encircling the sun, which aligns with the context of the passage.
 
• Other options ("**precise**", "**straight**", "**direct**") do not fit the context of describing the Earth's orbital path.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The fact that the wetter periods in North Africa have recurred__ every 21,000 years or so is a big clue about what *__*causes*__* them: variations in Earth’s orbit. Due to gravitational influences from the moon and other planets in our solar system, the orbit of the Earth **__around__** the sun is not constant. It has cyclic ______4_______ on multi-thousand year timescales. These orbital cycles _______5_______ the amount of energy the Earth receives from the sun. On 100,000-year cycles, the shape of Earth’s orbit shifts between circular and oval.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Precise (सटीक): "Precise" means exact or accurate, which does not fit the context of describing the Earth's orbit pathway.
 
• Straight (सीधा): "Straight" means extending in one direction without bending or curving, which does not reflect the nature of an orbit.
 
• Direct (प्रत्यक्ष): "Direct" means extending or moving from one place to another without changing direction or stopping, which does not align with describing an orbital pathway.
